notes: Reports are now available to PDO, President, and Member roles and open a menu with three actions: Send by Email, Save a copy, or Open PDF.
Income Statement and Balance Sheet reports can now be sent as PDF attachments through your phone's email app.
Each generated report is automatically saved as a local PDF copy to a folder you choose.
New Email Settings screen lets you configure the recipient email, sender name, default subject and message, CC/BCC, and the folder where reports are saved.
